title: Wes goes on the road with Snookum Russell
summary: Wes accepted an offer to join Snookum Russell's band, when Monk first heard Ray Brown's name.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Well, what was it that finally turned you to music?

It's very strange. I remember a couple of things happened to me. One, the last one, really took the biggest effect. One thing happened, I remember Wes went on the road. It was the first time he'd gone out on the road. And I was sort of like...it struck me a little funny when, even though we'd gone our separate ways, we weren't living under the same roof as brothers...youngsters coming up, we'd turned into our adulthood. And I had my family and he had his family,

And I remember the occasion, it came about that he was gonna go on the road. And I'd come by Mama's house and he was telling us about it, that he had an offer to go with Snookum Russell. Now, Snookum Russell had quite a name, so we knew that was quite a thing.
He was in that band the same time Ray Brown was...

Right, I was gonna say this. As a matter of fact, that's when I first heard Ray Brown's name come up to me. I'm not, still, in the music; I still wasn't into it. But Wes was talking about going on the road with this band and what a great musical venture it was for him.

It was in his blood, it was in there. Not only that, he was a good musician. It wasn't that he was going on a wild goose chase. He went away with that band, and he stayed for a period of time, months I guess, I'm not sure. But when he came back, I remember very distinctly when he came back.
